senses.gloss: † बीभ् बीभ्, or चीभ् चिभ्, i. 1, Ātm. To boast.
1. बीभत्स बीभत्स, an anomal. desider. probably of बाध्, Ātm. To be angry, to detest, Utt. Rāmac. 6, 6 (with abl.).

2. बीभत्स बीभत्स, i. e. बीभत्स + अ,
 I. m. Disgust, abhorrence.
 II. adj.
 1. Loathing, detesting.
 2. Loathful, Utt. Rāmac. 99, 9; Pañc. iii. d. 112.
 3. Mischievous, cruel.
 4. Envious.
 --Comp.
बीभत्सु बीभत्सु, i. e. बीभत्स + उ, [] adj. Envious, emulous, Arj. 3, 1 (read बिभ्˚).
